results.title: Over 12 lakh to get SIR notices in Hyderabad – Check status online
results.description: Hyderabad: More than 12 lakh voters in Hyderabad will get notices related to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. These notices will be served to both 5,80,908 unmapped voters and 6,72,678 electors whose details have anomalies. results.title: Nandi-Ndaitwah honours Pohamba at 91
results.description: Sostenus Wilherm President Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah has hailed former President Hifikepunye Pohamba as a symbol of sacrifice, service and dedication to Namibia as he celebrates his 91st birthday. results.title: Watch as ‘Kubala King’s’ wife unveils mysterious oracle he built in Sunyani before arrest
results.description: A video has surfaced online showing the state of an alleged kingdom built by self-styled Kubala King, Kofi Agyemang Offeh, before his arrest in Ghana.
